Embedded camera images are checksum-verified source bytes, scaled only for layout.
No source code was executed and no robot or simulator was controlled.
For linear_speed segments, speed is the mean; start_speed and end_speed specify the instantaneous endpoints. The shared scene clock integrates each ramp exactly.
